tracks.title: Whiteboard
tracks.summary: Sketch and diagram on a live Excalidraw canvas that you and your agents edit together.
tracks.overview:
**Whiteboard** is a local Excalidraw canvas at `/whiteboard`. You draw with the usual infinite-canvas tools, and your agents draw on the **same** canvas.

- **The canvas.** Shapes, arrows, lines, freehand, text, images and the eraser, plus pan and zoom. The toolbar above it shows whether the canvas engine is **Connected**.
- **Boards and templates.** Save the canvas as a named board and load it later; start from a built-in template: blank, flowchart, mind map, wireframe or kanban. Boards live in the plugin's data folder and survive turning the plugin off and on.
- **Agents that draw.** The bundled MCP engine gives agents `excalidraw_*` tools to create shapes and diagrams, connect elements, group, align, zoom and export. The **Canvas Architect** panel on the page sends a drawing request to the canvas agent.
- **The canvas floater.** A **Canvas** button in the command bar opens the same canvas in a floating window over any page.

Nothing runs while the plugin is off: no page, no topbar button, no RPCs and no agent tools. The tours switch tools and open panels, but never save, clear or send a drawing request.

walkthroughs.title: Draw on the canvas
walkthroughs.summary: The toolbar, the connection status and the drawing tools.

steps.title: The whiteboard toolbar
steps.body: Boards, templates, save, clear, refresh and open-in-a-new-tab live here, above the canvas.

steps.title: Connected
steps.body: **Connected** means the canvas engine is live, so changes from you and your agents land on the same scene.

steps.title: The canvas
steps.body: An infinite Excalidraw canvas. Hold the mouse wheel or Space while dragging to pan; use the zoom controls in the corner.

steps.title: Pick a shape tool
steps.body: Click the **Rectangle** tool, then drag on the canvas to draw one. Number keys switch tools too.

steps.title: Back to selection
steps.body: Click **Selection** to move, resize and style what you've drawn.

walkthroughs.title: Boards and templates
walkthroughs.summary: Save a canvas as a board, reopen it, or start from a template.

steps.title: Your saved boards
steps.body: Click **Boards** to see every canvas you've saved.

steps.title: Open or delete a board
steps.body: Click a board to load it onto the canvas. The bin icon deletes it. Boards are stored in the plugin's data folder.

steps.title: Start from a template
steps.body: Click **Templates**.

steps.title: Pick a starting layout
steps.body: Templates are grouped by category: blank, flowchart, mind map, wireframe and kanban. Picking one replaces what's on the canvas, so save first.

practice.note: The tour doesn't load a template: that would replace the current canvas.

steps.title: Save to Boards
steps.body: **Save to Boards** asks for a name and stores the current canvas.

practice.note: The tour doesn't save a board.

steps.title: Clear Canvas
steps.body: **Clear Canvas** wipes every element after a confirmation. Saved boards are not affected.

practice.note: Clearing deletes what's on the canvas, so the tour never presses it.

walkthroughs.title: Let an agent draw
walkthroughs.summary: The Canvas Architect panel and the excalidraw tools your agents use.

steps.title: Canvas Architect
steps.body: This panel talks to the canvas agent, a diagram specialist. If it's collapsed, the 🎨 button opens it.

steps.title: Ideas to start from
steps.body: Click a suggestion to put it in the prompt, or write your own.

steps.title: Describe the diagram
steps.body: Type what you want drawn.

action.sample: Draw a flowchart for user login

steps.title: Sending the request
steps.body: Send starts the canvas agent, which draws straight onto this canvas with the `excalidraw_*` tools. Any agent with those tools can do the same from chat: create shapes and diagrams, connect, group, align, zoom and export.

practice.note: The tour doesn't send: it would start an agent run on your model provider.

walkthroughs.title: The canvas on any page
walkthroughs.summary: Open the whiteboard in a floating window from the command bar.

steps.title: Canvas in the command bar
steps.body: Click **Canvas** in the command bar. On a phone it sits under **More** (⋯).

steps.title: Open Canvas
steps.body: Pick **Canvas**.

steps.title: A floating canvas
steps.body: The same canvas, over whatever page you're on. Drag the header to move it, drag an edge to resize, and minimise it when you need the page back.

steps.title: Close it
steps.body: Click **×** to close the floater, or click **Canvas** again. The canvas itself is unchanged.

steps.title: Close from the menu
steps.body: On a phone, pick **Canvas** again to close the floater.

quiz.prompt: When an agent draws with the excalidraw tools, where does the drawing appear?
options: In a separate file you have to import
On the same live canvas you see on the Whiteboard page
Only in the agent's chat reply as an image
quiz.explain: People and agents edit one shared canvas.

quiz.prompt: What happens to the current canvas when you pick a template?
options: The template is added to a new tab
The template replaces what's on the canvas
It is merged into your saved boards
quiz.explain: Save the canvas to Boards first if you want to keep it.

quiz.prompt: How do you get the whiteboard over another page?
options: Click Canvas in the command bar to open the floating canvas
Drag the Whiteboard sidebar item onto the page
quiz.explain: The Canvas topbar button opens a movable, resizable floater.

quiz.prompt: What happens to your saved boards if you turn the Whiteboard plugin off?
options: They stay in the plugin's data folder and come back when you turn it on
quiz.explain: Boards survive disable and re-enable cycles.
